summary: Cut at 6.8. This is round 5, the last of the two extra rounds Logan granted. Earlier rounds scored 5.6, 6.2, 6.3 and 6.6. Caiman scores 7 and the ship bar is 7.5. Basiliscus was cut at 7.2 and Kraken at 7.0. Two things stop a ship. (A) A gate is red. report.json records gates_passed false, and draft.pass, coarse.pass and export.pass are all false because thinnest_wall_pass is false. The wall census reads 79 samples under 0.8 mm. 74 of them belong to the bare native 006 at its palm bore edge. The other 5 are added by the design: single samples of 0.50 to 0.80 mm at about [-6.64, 10.80, 8.44], [-2.95, 11.06, 8.46], [7.06, -8.65, 1.05] and [8.98, -6.71, -1.08]. Under the rules a red gate is an automatic revise, but no round remains. (B) The art is below the bar even with every gate green. The face is now good. The 7.5 mm face leaves stand 0.7 mm, are domed, carry crisp spines and inked veins, and the parting-line seam is gone. The face berries sit in a neat triangle, and the table matte is one field. The cheek berries are regrouped into a triangle (v 15.77 against 16.79), and the template gate is recorded again (1 patch, 828,279 bytes, cold reload identical). The rest of the ring has not caught up. (1) Each cheek still has two leaves, not three. They are 0.3 mm thin wafers, and the end wall under them is still swollen and lumpy (cheek.png, side.png). (2) The garland is still flat, vertical-walled bat plates on a straight bar of 26 struck capsule stamps. The bar ends in a rounded stub that runs past the last leaf (garland.png), and the leaves have no pillow. (3) The shoulder stipple still renders as large triangulated facets with a ragged edge (garland.png, reverse.png). In hero.png the table matte reads as scattered dashes, and it smears at the table's inset edge (leaf.png). (4) The palm and lower flanks are bare polish with the stock's banding. Density is well below Caiman and the Reptilia sheet. Holly reads clearly at 300 px. But the ring is a polished box with a fine badge on top and lesser ornaments elsewhere, short of Logan's 'most insane rings we've done'. No round remains, so the ring is cut. If Logan reopens it, the face sprig is worth keeping as a stamp set for a later ring.
strengths: Face leaves at 7.5 mm and 0.7 mm high, pillowed, with crisp spine points and inked midrib and veins. There is no parting-line seam or notch now (leaf.png, stones.png, face.png). This is the best passage the ring has had in five rounds.
Face berries are a tidy triangle in made gypsy-mound seats, berry-red and fully visible. The sprig says holly at 300 px with no caption (hero-300.png, face-300.png).
Cheek berries are regrouped from a straight row into a triangle bunch, apex toward the table (placed.cheek v 15.772 against 16.789; cheek.png).
The table carries one continuous matte field with polished halos round the motifs. The two-panel box is gone for good.
The template gate is restored: verification.json gives 1 design.set patch, 828,279 bytes under the 1 MB stock budget, and cold design and graph reloads identical.
The native 006 keeps a flat table and the factory's hard wall-to-face angles (bare-vs-finished.png).

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: Holly on the face, both cheeks and both shoulders; the palm is bare by plan. The stipple is a field, not a stray motif.

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: hero-300 and face-300: two spined leaves flanking three red berries read as holly at once.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true, crisp outlines
checklist.reason: The face leaves are crisp now. But the garland stem is a chain of struck capsules ending in a stub past the last leaf (garland.png). The shoulder stipple renders as triangulated facets with a ragged border. The table matte smears into streaks at its inset edge (leaf.png, left side).

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured as fruit
checklist.reason: Nine garnets in gypsy-mound seats, all visible and berry-red. The face and both cheeks now carry triangle bunches, not rows.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The cheek leaves (0.3 mm) and garland leaves (0.34-0.45 mm) are flat plates with vertical walls and no pillow. The garland stem is a straight bar. The cheek end wall below the leaves is lumpy and swollen (cheek.png, side.png).

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Native 006, no sand master: the table edges are crisp in hero.png and bare-vs-finished.png.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from other Vepres rings
checklist.reason: The square 19.2 x 17 signet with a parting-line garland is unique in the collection so far.

checklist.item: Large, medium, small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large (face leaves) and small (berries, veins, matte) are present, but the medium tier is thin: two wafer leaves a cheek and plate garland leaves. The lower flanks and palm are bare polish with stock banding (palm.png). That is well under Caiman's or Varanus's fully worked surfaces.
